rationale: Retaining the db row for a file that exists but cannot be read or whose id ≠ stem means db wins for that ULID until the file is repaired — a real if narrow exception to file-wins, so it is an evidence fold into the DD-8 decision, not a code comment. Absence still deletes, so deliberate removals (dismiss/removeEntities unlink the file) propagate unchanged.
summary: Ingest retention is recorded as a narrow, named exception to DD-8: an unreadable or mis-keyed record file is not a file and cannot 'win'; precedence for parseable files is unchanged
